blocks.text: A respiratory tract infection is an infectious disease caused by viral, bacterial or other microbial pathogens affecting the upper or lower respiratory system, including the airways and lungs.

Pneumonia is an infection of the lung parenchyma characterized by inflammation and consolidation of the alveoli, most commonly caused by bacterial, viral, or fungal pathogens.

blocks.text: Patients with pneumonia should be afebrile for 48-72hours and have improved clinically before antibiotic therapy is stopped. The duration of therapy may need to be increased if the initial empirical therapy has no activity against the specific pathogen or if the pneumonia is complicated by extra pulmonary infection.
